reportsLibrary.title: Reports
reportsLibrary.sub: Pick a question, see the answer. Pin the numbers you want on Home.

cards.profit: Did we make money after all costs?
cards.aov: How big is an average order?
cards.discount: How much did we give in discounts?
cards.chprofit: Which channel earns the most profit?
cards.newc: How many new customers did we get?
cards.toparea: Where do most orders come from?
cards.confirmtime: How fast do we confirm new orders?

restock.title: Restock now
restock.sub: Styles that sold in the last 30 days and a size is out or the stock is running short.
restock.unsoldSub: In stock, old enough and nothing sold in the last 30 days.

time.title: When orders come in
time.sub: Orders by weekday and by hour of the day, in the shop's time, for the period above.

review.title: Monthly review
review.sub: Last month ({from} to {to}) in a few lines, from the numbers. Nothing is guessed.
review.sales: Sales were {amount}, {pct}% {dir} than the month before.
review.profit: Net profit was {amount}, {pct}% {dir} than the month before.
review.profitUnknown: Net profit is not known yet (the ad spend is missing).

views.title: Saved views
views.sub: Keep this period and the compare switch under a name, and open it again in one tap.
views.name: Name this view

err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.CONFLICT: Too many saved views. Remove one first.
err.other: It could not be saved. Try again.

dl.title: Downloads & report packs
dl.sub: For a bank or loan application, a partner, or your own analysis. PDF on your letterhead, or Excel with one sheet per part.

monthly.name: Monthly business pack
monthly.d: For yourself or a partner, every month

bank.name: Bank pack
bank.d: For a bank loan or credit application

stock.name: Stock pack
stock.d: Stock, what to buy and what is not selling

sales.name: Sales pack
sales.d: Sales, orders by weekday, profit and discounts

single.title: Single reports
single.sub: Uses the period you last picked

dl.printFail: The print window did not open. The PDF is open in a new tab; print it from there.

daily.title: Daily business report
daily.note: Every night: orders, delivered sales, profit, returns, stock to restock and what is waiting for tomorrow. Sent to you only (never to a buyer or a supplier).
daily.failed: It was not saved. Try again.

line.subProfitUnknown: Not known yet: the ad spend is missing
line.subRestock: still selling, a size runs out within 14 days
line.subDead: no sale in this period, 30+ pieces in stock
line.subRepeat: ordered more than once, all time
line.subCheckoutj: where visitors stop in checkout, and how many we win back
line.subCourier: best success: {pct}% of {n} parcels · every courier compared

reportsLibrary.footerNote: Money and the books (profit & loss statement, expenses, COD with couriers) are in Finance. Visitors and the website funnel are in Website › Analytics.
reportsLibrary.reviewLine: net profit {profit} on {sales} delivered sales. What went well, what went badly and 3 things to do.
reportsLibrary.reviewLineUnknown: net profit not known yet (the ad spend is missing), on {sales} delivered sales. What went well, what went badly and 3 things to do.
reportsLibrary.filterNote: Filter on: sales, profit, average order, top product, best and worst area and returns use only the orders you picked, with ads and office costs shared by sales. Stock, customers, ads, the team, couriers and open checkouts stay for the whole shop.
